While I believe in free speech overall, there are limits when it comes to spreading ideas that are clearly wrong and hurtful. It’s important to protect the community from hateful and false claims.

questions.question: Do you think sexual relations between a man and a woman before marriage are always wrong, almost always wrong, wrong only sometimes, or not wrong at all?
questions.answer: I believe that sexual relations between a man and a woman before marriage are wrong only sometimes, depending on the situation and maturity of those involved. However, if we're talking about young teens, like those between 14 and 16 years old, I think it is always wrong. At that age, they’re just too young to handle something so serious responsibly. My values are shaped by my upbringing and my faith, and I want to see young people make good choices.

questions.question: Can you think of any situation where you would approve of a policeman hitting an adult man?
questions.answer: I generally don’t think it’s right for a policeman to hit an adult man, no matter the situation. However, if the man was actually attacking the officer with his fists, then I could see that being justified. Outside of that, even if the person was rude or suspected of serious crimes, I wouldn’t approve of police using physical force. I believe law enforcement should handle things without resorting to hitting unless absolutely necessary for self-defense.
